channel.title: The Travel Show
channel.desc: As Rome marks a monumental year in its recent history, Qasa Alom heads to a city in the middle of a metamorphosis. By the end of 2025, millions of pilgrims are expected to have visited the Italian capital to celebrate its jubilee, and also to mark the death of Pope Francis and the election of Pope Leo XIV. The Travel Show explores Rome's food, infrastructure and heritage to see how this ancient city's looking to modernise for visitors while satisfying the Roman's taste for tradition.
